title: Schools and the theater
content: I do find it vary interesting that everyone seems to have the theater in their dreams. Allot of people have them linked to a school. I have a story about this, that to me, I confirmed it was supernatural. I can't necessarily prove it in totality to the internet but its one of those experiences that I (just know it is) Anyways I had this reoccurring mall world dream and it would have a stretch of my old high-school (I Believe its the same place everyone else goes, we just see it though our own lense) I would be wondering the halls and then turn down a hall where there was some classrooms in real life. However the classrooms where gone and it went into a new hallway that looked like a college campus. I would enter through a door there and end up in the theater. On the stage there was a big portal and you could use it to go to parallel universes. (The mall world dreams videos I posted 7 year ago center around that portal) Anyways those dreams started in 2011. I was in 11th grade. Had them consistently until 2016. Thing is in 2016 they built an extension onto the school and a theater in it. They built it right where those classrooms where down that hall. In 2020 I got a job at the high-school as a janitor. Starting was vary nostalgic. Thought the new additions would ruin some nostalgia. But it was exactly those dreams. The college campus part is called the concourse and they built the theater. Everything is exactly the same as the dream. I was still hit with nostalgia being in these new parts I've never been in, because I seen them in my dreams for years. In the theater, people say they believe its haunted because of the creepy vibe in there. I got to wonder because that's where the portal was in my dreams. That theater is only 9 years old, why would it be haunted already? Vary weird experience to be nostalgic about a place I was technically visiting for the first time. Anyways I've had a reoccurring dream about the elevator at the school breaking when I am in it and I get crushed. So since one reoccurring school dream came true, I avoid that elevator.
